title: Social Media in practice
intro: Think for a moment before you post. Decide what you would do in each moment from this module's lessons.

decisions.title: Message from Kontakto
decisions.prompt: Is this message safe or a threat?

artifact.name: Kontakto
body: New sign-in to your account: Baku, phone. If this was not you, open Security in the app.

decisions.explain: No link and no code request, it sends you to the app itself. Do the check inside the app.

decisions.title: Message from Gunel Rzayeva
decisions.prompt: Is this message safe or a threat?

artifact.name: Gunel Rzayeva
body: Hi! My daughter is in a contest, please vote for her. You will get a code by SMS, send it to me.

decisions.explain: That code is the key to your account. Never share it, even if the message comes from a friend's account.

decisions.title: Message from Kamran Aliyev · no mutual contacts
decisions.prompt: Is this message safe or a threat?

artifact.name: Kamran Aliyev · no mutual contacts
body: Hi, we work in the same field. Could you send me your head of department's mobile number?

decisions.explain: A stranger is looking for a way to reach your manager. Give contact details only through official channels.

decisions.title: Message from Official Press Office
decisions.prompt: Is this message safe or a threat?

artifact.name: Official Press Office
body: To verify your account, send your job title, work email and date of birth.

decisions.explain: Official bodies do not ask for this on social media. Do not reply, and report the profile.

decisions.title: Message from Aysel Guliyeva (colleague)
decisions.prompt: Is this message safe or a threat?

artifact.name: Aysel Guliyeva (colleague)
body: Tomorrow's meeting moved to 11, same room.

decisions.explain: A known colleague, no request, nothing sensitive. This message is safe.
